name: deploy_create
description: Create a new deployment unit in z-ops. A deployment unit represents a single release being pushed to a specific environment. Use this when the CEO agent needs to push a build: e.g. 'deploy v1.2.0 to staging'. The deployment will be queued and processed asynchronously by the configured runner. Returns the new deployment id and initial status. Backed by POST /api/ops/deployment. Requires z-ctc 'ops:deploy' permission.

version.description: Version tag or build id. e.g. 'v1.2.0' or 'git-sha-abc123'.

environment.description: Target environment. Determines URL, DB, signing keys.

targetId.description: Deployment target id (from meta_query metaType=target). Specifies the cluster/region.

buildArtifact.description: URL or path to the build artifact. e.g. 'ghcr.io/zifang/z-biz-news:v1.2.0' or 's3://builds/z-biz-news-v1.2.0.apk'.

rollbackOn.description: Optional: list of health-check conditions to monitor. If any fails, auto-rollback. e.g. ['http_5xx_rate<0.1%', 'p99_latency<500ms'].

approver.description: z-ctc username who approved this deploy. e.g. 'admin'.
